name: Intralesional interferon α-2b
question: Does intralesional interferon α-2b improve penile deformity and symptoms more than saline injections in men with Peyronie's disease?

design.population: Men with Peyronie's disease enrolled across multiple centers (mean age 55.1 years), with symptoms longer than 12 months, curvature at least 30°, and no calcified plaque according to the AUA guideline's account of eligibility.
design.locator: Hellstrom 2006 PubMed abstract, Materials and Methods; AUA 2015 guideline p13

verdictNote: Curvature, plaque and pain outcomes favored interferon; erectile-function scores did not.
takeaway: Intralesional interferon α-2b improved penile curvature, plaque size and density, and pain more than saline placebo after a 12-week injection course; mean erectile-function score change did not differ significantly.

reports.label: Penile Doppler analysis
reports.citation: Kendirci M, Usta MF, Matern RV, Nowfar S, Sikka SC, Hellstrom WJ. "The impact of intralesional interferon alpha-2b injection therapy on penile hemodynamics in men with Peyronie's disease." *J Sex Med.* 2005;2(5):709-715. doi:10.1111/j.1743-6109.2005.00110.x
reports.followUp: After six injections administered every other week

results.measure: Penile blood-flow improvement by duplex Doppler ultrasound in the 39-patient analysis
results.note: The abstract reports a significant between-group difference without numerical blood-flow estimates.
The abstract reports a significant increase within the interferon arm.

values.exp: 19 patients; 5 million units every other week for six injections
values.ctl: 20 patients; 10 mL saline every other week for six injections

reports.label: Multicenter efficacy and safety report
reports.dateLocator: PubMed citation and Crossref published-print: July 2006; day not reported
reports.citation: Hellstrom WJ, Kendirci M, Matern R, et al. "Single-blind, multicenter, placebo controlled, parallel study to assess the safety and efficacy of intralesional interferon alpha-2B for minimally invasive treatment for Peyronie's disease." *J Urol.* 2006;176(1):394-398. doi:10.1016/S0022-5347(06)00517-9

results.note: The abstract reports the between-group difference as significant and does not name a primary endpoint.
Both plaque measures favored interferon significantly in the abstract.
The abstract reports a significant between-group difference.

results.measure: Change in mean International Index of Erectile Function score
results.note: The between-group difference was not statistically significant.

harms.label: Adverse effects, predominantly flu-like symptoms

values.exp: Frequent; mild to moderate and short-lived

harms.note: Event counts and denominators were not given in the abstract.

values.exp: 5 million units of interferon α-2b every other week for 12 weeks
values.ctl: 10 mL saline every other week for 12 weeks
